Job Description reputed company's Product Management team is adding a Product Analyst for Prism. Prism is our conversational analytics platform. It lets the people who work in market access at life sciences companies ask questions about their data in plain English and get answers back in seconds, instead of handing the request to an analyst and waiting. Behind the scenes, Prism runs on semantic layers we build from our raw SQL data, and those layers are what let it take a business question and map it to the right numbers. The Product Analyst is the person who makes sure the questions people ask actually line up with the answers Prism gives back. You'll work day to day with Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering to keep those answers accurate and worth trusting. This isn't a development role, and it isn't about building reports or dashboards. It's an analysis role for someone who is technical but isn't a software engineer. You'll use reputed company reputed company along with tools like Claude and Codex to review and improve the prompts business users type into Prism and the answers it sends back. A lot of the work is finding the spots where the data is set up in a way that leads Prism to misread a question or return the wrong answer. Roughly half the job is digging into the data itself. The other half is talking to the business owners, certifying that queries return the right results, and writing up what needs to reputed company. What This Role Entails Prompt review Go through the prompts business users type into Prism and improve them, using reputed company reputed company and tools like Claude and Codex, so their questions get read correctly against the semantic layer. Query certification Check user queries and the answers Prism gives back, confirm they hold up against the source data, and sign off so the business can trust the results. Quality ownership Keep an eye on the questions users ask and the answers they get, and watch for repeat errors, gaps, or misreads so they get fixed. Semantic layer work Work with Data Science and Engineering to improve the semantic layers built from the raw SQL tables, including the taxonomies, metadata, and labeling, so Prism understands the data better. Data analysis Dig into how data connects across pricing, rebates, chargebacks, and other areas, and use what you find to shape how that data is represented in Prism. Working with the business Talk to business owners about the questions they need answered, and turn those conversations into better prompts, queries, and data structure. Writing requirements Write clear technical requirements for tuning the model, changing how data is structured, or reputed company the product, based on what your reviews turn up. Documentation Document where the data comes from, the business logic behind it, and how things relate, so people can understand and trust Prism's answers. Roadmap input Be the voice for data quality in planning and prioritization for Prism, so decisions are based on what the data actually says. QA and communication Work with QA to set up test reputed company for answer accuracy each sprint, and help with internal and customer updates (release notes, briefings, presentations) that explain how Prism works. Qualifications What You'll Bring to the Table At least 3 years in data analysis, data correlation, or similar analytical work. Strong technical skills without being a software engineer. You're comfortable with SQL, semantic layers, and data structures, and you can dig into a problem on your own. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. People first. Ownership always. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. matches.d: This is a remote position. Role overview Our client is an Australian technology company whose AI voice agent platform answers and handles phone calls for businesses in Australia and New Zealand. As a Product Analyst , your responsibility is to research the AI voice agent market and turn it into clear, build-ready feature documents for our client's development team. This role is the bridge between the market and the product. You will study what competitors offer, analyse what the platform should build next, and write specifications the CTO can act on. The Founder & CEO makes final decisions on what gets built. Business owners create their own AI agents that can answer questions, book appointments, collect caller details, send SMS messages and transfer calls to staff. The platform is fully self-serve: customers set up and manage their agents, and handle any escalated calls themselves. The platform is built on its own technology stack using leading speech and language AI models, and is designed to work across industries. Key Responsibilities Market and competitor research Identify and track AI voice agent and call-handling platforms, globally and in Australia and New Zealand. Sign up for competitor free trials, build test agents and call demo numbers to experience their products first-hand. Monitor competitor feature releases, pricing changes, integrations and new market entrants. Feature analysis Break down how competitors design and deliver specific features, including user flows, settings and limitations. Assess which features are standard expectations and which could set the platform apart. Research third-party integrations (CRMs, calendars, booking systems, helpdesks) and how they connect to voice agent platforms. Feature documentation Write clear, structured feature specification documents using the client's standard format. Present feature documents to the Founder & CEO for review and approval. Hand approved specifications to the CTO and answer the development team's questions about them. Keep a prioritised feature backlog up to date. Platform insight Review anonymised call transcripts and recordings to spot where agents struggle or callers get confused. Analyse platform usage data, such as feature adoption and drop-off during agent setup. Review support tickets and cancellation feedback for recurring issues and feature requests. Product quality Test new features once built against the approved specification and report gaps. Help maintain product documentation and help-centre content for new features. Requirements Skills and Experience Essential 1–3 years in a product analyst, business analyst, QA or similar role at a software or SaaS company. Excellent written English, with the ability to write clear, structured documents for both business and technical readers. Strong research and analytical skills, with a habit of testing products hands-on rather than relying on marketing pages. Ability to understand software features and user flows, and explain them simply. Confident using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, analysis and drafting. Organised and self-directed, able to manage several research topics at once and meet agreed deadlines. Reliable home internet and a quiet workspace suitable for remote work. Desirable Familiarity with AI voice agents, chatbots or conversational AI products. Basic understanding of APIs and how software integrations work. Work Environment & Expectations While this is a work-from-home position, it is important to note that this is a full-time role—not a freelance or flexible-hour arrangement. You will be expected to work a fixed shift and maintain a high level of professionalism and accountability, just as you would in an office environment. ✅ This role requires: Discipline and commitment to set working hours (strict shift times, not flexible) Use of time tracking software during work hours Active participation in team and client calls with your camera ON Consistent availability and responsiveness throughout your shift Treating this as a long-term, full-time job—not a side gig or freelance task ⏱Payroll is processed bi-monthly. We’re looking for someone who values structure, is dependable, and thrives in a role that provides consistency and clarity. If you’re seeking stability and a team that appreciates reliability, we’d love to hear from you. Benefits Monthly Salary: PHP 45,000 Salary will be paid on a bi-monthly basis on the 15th and 30th or 31st of each month You will be paid extra for overtime and Philippines public holidays Probation: 6 months and after Probation - 10 days annual leave credits - 5 days of sick leave HMO offered after 6-months' probation Eligible for 13th Month Pay after 30 days Annual Salary Review Laptop provided after 30 days Permanent work-from-home role. matches.d: Job Description A bit about this role: Devoted Health engages in millions of member interactions every year through a frontline organization of team members and AI agents spanning Member Service, Specialty Care Coordination, and Member Outreach, Sales and more. The quality of those interactions is the mission. Every call, every outreach, every touchpoint is a moment where we either earn or lose a member's trust. Getting this right at scale requires a fundamentally new approach. You will build AI systems that monitor the quality of every member interaction and turn those signals into coaching and feedback that elevates both frontline team performance and frontline AI agent performance. You will define what high performance looks like across these teams and AI agents and build the systems that ensure we hit our goals. You will be a close thought partner to the leaders of our frontline teams, ensuring that every tool you build is adopted and helps them meaningfully improve performance. This is a new role, and you will shape what AI-native quality and performance operations looks like for this organization. Your Responsibilities and Impact will include: Embed with frontline teams and their leaders to understand what quality looks like in practice: how members are engaged, where interactions break down, and how coaching happens (or doesn't) today. Own the performance of our highest volume frontline AI agents, across voice and chat, and continue to build out those agents to drive higher performance. Build AI-powered quality monitoring systems that move the needle on our most important business outcomes. Evaluate member interactions in real time across millions of touchpoints, moving beyond pass/fail scoring to nuanced assessment of what actually matters for member experience, safety, and outcomes. Build coaching workflows that surface actionable feedback to leaders at all levels immediately, making every interaction an opportunity to improve. Every key stakeholder should have an approach to action on results so that we’re getting better every day. Visualize interaction data, evaluation criteria, coaching signals, and performance trends so the right insight reaches the right person at the right time, from rep to team lead to senior leader. Scale what works. Turn successful systems into reusable frameworks that extend to new teams, interaction types, and channels. What works for Member Service should accelerate what you build for Specialty Care Coordination, Member Outreach, and our Clinician orgs. Partner closely with frontline team leaders across levels, coaching them on how to use the tools you build, ensuring adoption, and iterating in real time in response to their feedback to drive value. Oversee a small team of operators and agent builders that will drive performance across all frontline agents and teams Required skills and experience: 4+ years in high-ownership operator roles: startup strategy, biz ops, consulting, or internal tooling PM. You have built and run systems that made organizations meaningfully more effective, and you move quickly to working prototypes on real data with real feedback. People leadership experience: you have directly managed, mentored, or grown individuals or teams, and you bring that lens to every cross-functional partnership. You know how to build trust quickly, give feedback that lands, and create the conditions for people around you to do their best work. Fluency with modern AI tools and platforms, with an active practice of pushing their limits. You're adaptive and curious — willing to learn, teach, lead, and follow. Strong data fluency: You self-serve analysis and reason from data rigorously: you know which numbers actually drive the business, can spot when a metric is misleading, and turn ambiguous data into clear insights on quality. Systems thinking: you move from solving a single issue to designing a framework that prevents an entire category of issues. You generalize your work and think in feedback loops, not isolated fixes. An instinct for quality in human interactions: you translate intuition about what a good member experience feels like into structured criteria an AI system can apply at scale. You care deeply about doing what's right for members and the teams serving them. A coaching and enabling mindset: you work with frontline managers and quality leads to ensure AI-generated insights actually change behavior. You challenge assumptions, do what makes sense even when it's unconventional, and care more about outcomes than credit. Exceptional communication: you tailor your style to move teams to action, from frontline guides to executives. You're comfortable with ambiguity and take ownership of outcomes end to end. matches.d: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. This role offers location flexibility and is open to candidates across the United States. Candidates based in the Dallas–Fort Worth (DFW) area will be hired in a hybrid capacity and are expected to work onsite at our Las Colinas office a minimum of two (2) days per week, with the remaining days worked remotely. Specific in‑office days may be designated based on team needs and business priorities. About the Role: The Product Operations Analyst will execute the definition of product performance tracking and portfolio insights and strategic reporting for the operating model across Pharmacy Management, Clinical Service and Inventory Optimization technology products. This role will be responsible for AI-forward product performance standards that drive customer experience and growth across products. This individual sits at the intersection of product operations, data, and engineering to drive product health reporting and performance dashboard infrastructure definition, visualization, and review cadences. Furthermore, this role will partner closely with Product, Data Insights, and Customer Success teams on portfolio-level metric level definition and synthesize customer insights to delineate data decisions that accelerate product delivery. Reporting to the Director of Product Operations & Strategy, this individual implements and refines data methodologies across the product organization. This role drives operational outcomes focused on actionable, evidence-based insights that guide product growth and business outcomes. This role works closely with Product Leadership, Engineering, Customer Success, Data Insights, Commercial teams and other McKesson organizations to drive our strategic objectives and operational efficiency and support business growth. McKesson Pharmacy System (MPS) is an independent business within the larger McKesson Commercial Strategy & Innovation (CSI) organization. What You'll Do: Product Performance Tracking Maintain and update the KPI taxonomy that defines how product health is measured and reported across the portfolio; use AI tools to ensure metrics are consistently defined and comparable while accommodating different business models. Build and maintain product performance dashboards; coordinate with Engineering teams to ensure the underlying instrumentation, data access, and visualizations are accurate and current. Craft templates and materials for product performance reviews; track the review cadence, follow up with PMs to collect inputs on schedule, and ensure submissions are grounded in data rather than qualitative narrative for executive audiences. Monitor product performance data on a recurring basis to identify early-warning signals; flag risks to relevant leads and support the escalation process by pulling the right data and engaging the right stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success. Aggregate and analyze product performance data across the product portfolio using AI tools to accelerate pattern recognition and prepare evidence-based insights that inform resource reallocation, acceleration, or sunset recommendations. Portfolio Insights & Strategic Reporting Synthesize data across product areas into a coherent narrative for leadership and flag anomalies or emerging risks proactively. Prepare executive summaries and KPI tracking templates; ensure all reporting is grounded in current data and formatted for the intended audience. Aggregate VOC data using AI-powered analysis to surface themes and patterns at scale; collaborate cross-functionally to maintain the feedback taxonomy and routing process to ensure insights reach the right leaders. Monitor the competitive landscape on a recurring basis; compile and summarize market intelligence, competitor product updates, and industry signals into impactful narratives that inform product and portfolio decisions. Champion the use of AI to identify recurring gaps or inconsistencies in how performance data is collected and reported across the portfolio. Product Operating Model Maturity Execute and continuously evaluate the scoring process for the product prioritization framework. Build core deliverables for PM training, onboarding, and enablement, leveraging AI to accelerate content development and refinement. Prepare materials to support coaching of PMs on prioritization, ROI sizing, experimentation, and planning. Support the administration of AI tooling that rapidly accelerates product operational workflows and reusable templates for product development. Identify opportunities to embed AI into operational workflows and champion adoption of AI-powered productivity practices across the product organization. Product Strategy Development Utilize AI-led tools and research concepts to capture critical data points regarding competitive landscape, customer needs, and market trends that influence decisions for the product strategy. Monitor roadmap inputs and progress and identify key data points for opportunity areas to accelerate delivery across the product portfolio. Basic Requirements: Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience. 4+ years of progressive experience in product management, product operations, technology consulting, analytics, or related technology transformation roles. Strong experience with Claude, Rovo, Figma or equivalent AI-first product tools to accelerate product development. Strong data analysis acumen with experience in Excel, SQL, R, Python or other comparable BI tools such as Power BI, Looker and Tableau. Strong understanding of product metrics fluency, dashboard reporting infrastructure, and prioritization frameworks. Strong organizational skills with the ability to collaborate with multiple, concurrent work streams and meet deadlines reliably. Strong cross-functional facilitation and collaboration: able to engage product, engineering, data, design, customer success and commercial leaders, to influence conversations, mitigate issues / decisions, document outcomes, and drive accountability. Strong analytical fluency governing product metric definitions, measuring product health, assessing product KPI taxonomy, and extracting insights from data within context in collaboration with cross-functional partners. Clear written communication and storytelling skills with the ability to produce clean, readable documentation and leadership-ready narrative. Comfortable coordinating across teams and following up on action items without formal authority. Preferred Skills/Experience: Experience with AI/automation tools for product management and design workflow acceleration. Experience supporting operating mechanisms for multi-product platform organizations where the operating model itself is a transformation deliverable. Familiarity with technical product concepts, cloud platforms, data ecosystems, and API-driven models is beneficial. Experience in healthcare, pharmacy operations, supply chain, or predictive analytics domains. Physical Requirements: Traditional office or hybrid environment, depending on location. Up to 10% travel required for cross-site collaboration and customer/partner engagements. McKesson complies with all applicable U.S. immigration laws and regulations. The Company does not provide employer support or sponsorship for any immigration related employment benefit for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a fulltime basis without the need for employer support or sponsorship now or in the future. This includes having the legal right to work in the United States without the need for McKesson support or sponsorship for any immigration related employment authorization (e.g., H1B, O1, E3, H1B1, TN, F1 OPT, F1 STEM OPT, F1 CPT, etc.) now or in the future. matches.d: Remote Opportunity - Canada, US applicants We're always looking for exceptional people. If you're passionate about what you do and want to be part of a pioneering team building purpose-built software for industrial equipment and commercial field service industry, we want to hear from you! RUX Software is a fast-growing Microsoft Business Central ISV serving 500+ clients globally across equipment rental, construction, scaffolding, trenching/shoring, oilfield services, medical equipment, and related verticals. We're engineered to fit the industries we serve, and we hire people the same way. RUX Software provides ERP solutions for industrial asset management and field service organizations. Built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, our applications help customers improve visibility, efficiency, and operational scalability. Overview Leads the design, development, testing, release, and support of complex Business Central and cross-platform mobile solutions. Serves as a technical leader by making sound design decisions, mentoring developers, resolving difficult technical problems, and improving engineering quality and delivery practices. What This Position Owns Visioning and Competitive Intelligence (20%): Shape domain direction using market signals, customer insight, and competitor analysis; propose strategic bets, positioning updates, and sequencing changes tied to business outcomes. Backlog and Sprint Readiness (15%): Own backlog health by prioritizing and preparing work so items are sprint-ready with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and delivery sequencing. Stakeholder and Cross-Team Alignment (10%): Align Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Implementation on priorities, timing, tradeoffs, and customer commitments so execution and messaging remain consistent. Customer Discovery and Validation (15%): Engage users and customers, including dispatchers, technicians, and service managers, to validate problems, test assumptions, and convert learning into better priorities and requirements. Solutioning and Tradeoff Work (10%): Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options and make practical decisions across customer value, effort, risk, scalability, and time to value. Escalations and Issue Triage (10%): Lead or coordinate priority customer and product issue response, including triage, decision-making, stakeholder communication, and prevention actions that reduce recurrence. Quality Validation and Platform Release Readiness (10%): Confirm product behavior through UAT support, regression validation, and release-impact checks; stay current on major platform releases and features to protect compatibility and identify product opportunities. Documentation Review and Enablement Readiness (5%): Verify release documentation is accurate, complete, and usable across customer-facing guides, internal support notes, and enablement materials. KPI Review and Outcome Tracking (5%): Monitor adoption and service-performance metrics, interpret outcome trends, and feed learning back into roadmap and backlog decisions. How Success Is Measured Success is measured by backlog health and sprint readiness; quality of product decisions and cross-team alignment; validated customer learning; timely resolution of priority issues; release quality and platform compatibility; documentation readiness; feature adoption; service-performance trends; and measurable movement in product and business outcomes. Responsibilities Build and maintain a fact-based product-domain perspective using customer feedback, support patterns, market signals, competitive research, platform changes, and performance data. Propose product bets, positioning changes, and roadmap sequencing updates with a clear connection to customer and business outcomes. Own and continuously prioritize the backlog based on customer value, strategic fit, revenue impact, risk, technical health, effort, and time to value. Translate priorities into sprint-ready work with clear problem statements, scope, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and sequencing. Lead backlog refinement and provide timely product decisions before and during development. Plan and conduct discovery with relevant users and customers, document findings, test assumptions, and incorporate validated learning into requirements and priorities. Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options, understand technical constraints, and make explicit tradeoff decisions. Align Support, Sales, Implementation, Product, and Engineering on priorities, timing, customer commitments, release impact, and messaging. Lead or coordinate triage for priority product and customer issues, including decision-making, stakeholder updates, and prevention follow-up. Support UAT, regression validation, and release-impact reviews to confirm that product behavior meets expectations. Monitor major Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and related platform releases for compatibility risks and product opportunities. Approve completed work against acceptance criteria and intended customer outcomes before release. Review customer-facing documentation, internal support notes, release communications, and enablement materials for accuracy and readiness. Monitor adoption and service KPIs, interpret trends, and use the findings to adjust roadmap, backlog, discovery, and enablement decisions. Qualifications Demonstrated experience owning a B2B software product area or product backlog and translating strategy, market insight, and customer problems into clear priorities and development outcomes. Strong capability in customer discovery, competitive analysis, requirements definition, backlog management, facilitation, stakeholder communication, issue triage, UAT, and data-informed decision-making. Experience with SaaS, ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and rental, service, field-service, or industrial-asset workflows is strongly preferred. Equal Opportunity Employer RUX Software is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to a workplace where employees are treated with dignity and respect. Originally posted on Himalayas

An overview of this role The AI Transformation Owner drives the end-to-end AI agenda for the field organization, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete enablement roadmaps, field use cases, and org-level strategy. You will partner closely with product and engineering teams to pilot and scale AI solutions, own the operational transformation plan needed to embed AI into day-to-day field workflows, and establish the governance framework that keeps AI adoption safe, compliant, and aligned with company standards. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from strategy to execution without heavy oversight. This role reports to the Vice President, Enablement & AI. What You’ll Do AI Enablement Roadmap: Own and continuously evolve the roadmap for AI-driven enablement initiatives, prioritizing based on field impact, feasibility, and alignment with broader Enterprise AI team and strategy.. AI Field Use Cases: Identify, scope, and execute on high-value AI use cases for the field (e.g., deal support, prospecting, content generation, guided selling, skills, change management), working with stakeholders to define success criteria and measure impact. AI Field Champions: build relationships with champions in the field organization to activate power-usage and drive peer-led adoption; track this adoption (e.g., usage, proficiency, behavior change) with our AI Ops Specialist and Enablement Analyst. Ops Transformation Plan: Design and drive the operational plan that turns AI pilots into scaled, repeatable processes, coordinating across enablement, ops, and technical teams to remove execution bottlenecks. AI Governance: Influence and lead governance standards for AI tool adoption in the field, including data usage, risk review, tool vetting, and alignment with company-wide AI policy. What You’ll Bring Mid-Senior Experience: Several years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related GTM function, with a track record of owning initiatives end-to-end. AI Solutions Experience: Direct experience evaluating, piloting, or deploying AI tools or solutions in a business context, with a solid technical understanding of how they work and where they add value. Act as the field's primary advocate for AI tools (e.g., AI-assisted prospecting, call intelligence, forecasting copilots, RFP/proposal generation). Cross-Functional Fluency: Proven ability to work closely with product and engineering teams, translating field needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Self-Sufficiency: Comfortable operating with significant autonomy — able to define scope, structure ambiguous problems, and drive work forward without needing detailed direction. Organization & Execution: Strong project management instincts; able to manage multiple workstreams (roadmap, use cases, ops transformation, governance) in parallel without dropping details. Innovative Mindset: A builder's orientation toward new technology — curious about what's possible, willing to experiment, and able to separate genuine opportunity from hype. Enablement/Sales Background: Familiarity with field or sales enablement motions (onboarding, tool adoption, content, coaching) and how AI can realistically augment them. GitLab Values Alignment: Ability to work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, leaning heavily on transparency and collaboration as defined in the GitLab Handbook. About the team The Enablement & AI function is part of the CRO organization. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. The enablement organization comprises enablement leads serving the CRO business functions, a centralized content group, AI tech resources, and an operations team. You proactively communicate progress and risks with internal and external stakeholders. You could be a great fit if: - 🙋You strike the balance between collaborative teamwork with a strong ability to execute independently on a defined plan. - 📣 You demonstrate clear communication. matches.d: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. At Vanta, our mission is to secure the internet and protect consumer data. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Our goal is to provide best-in-class Technical Support to our customers. Our team's mission: "We transform complexity into clarity in every interaction, with empathy, earning the trust of our customers" We build strong partnerships with our customers through trust and transparency, which is why our Technical Support Metrics https://www.vanta.com/technical-support-metrics are public. As the AI Agent Operations Specialist,You'll own Ask-Ilma, Vanta's customer-facing AI agent, built on Fin by Intercom, and the first point of contact for customers seeking support.. You're accountable for whether customers get the right answer, how the experience feels, and how smoothly Fin hands off to our support engineers when it should. Our customers rely on Vanta to get compliance right, so a fast answer only counts if it's also a correct one. This is a hands-on role for someone who treats an AI agent like a product: something to measure, tune, test, and improve every week. What you’ll do as a AI Optimization Specialist, Support at Vanta: PERFORMANCE: OWN HOW WELL FIN WORKS An AI agent's performance drifts without a clear owner, and that owner is you. You'll have a bias for action, shipping improvements quickly and learning from the results. You'll also decide with frameworks, so the team always understands why one fix came before another. - Review Fin conversations weekly to find wrong answers, self-service gaps, and avoidable escalations. - Make changes in Fin yourself (guidance, content, workflows). Treat most as two-way doors: ship, measure, adjust. - Keep a ranked list of improvements based on customer impact, volume, and risk. - Set and document Fin's guardrails: what it must never answer, when it asks a clarifying question, and when it escalates. KNOWLEDGE: OWN WHAT FIN KNOWS Fin is only as accurate as what it knows. Our customers trust Vanta to get compliance right, and we do what it says on the tin, so Fin's knowledge has to be correct and current. - Own the knowledge Fin draws from: snippets, internal content, and our help center. - Set the governance: every topic has an owner and a review cadence, and outdated or conflicting content gets retired. - When a support engineer answers something Fin couldn't, turn it into reusable knowledge so we only answer it once. - Set AI-ready content standards, and partner with Customer Education to bring help-center articles up to them. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE: OWN HOW FIN FEELS TO CUSTOMERS For many customers, Fin is the first Vanta "teammate" they talk to. Because we put our customers first, how Fin makes them feel matters as much as what it says. - Shape how Fin sounds, including how it says "I don't know" without leaving customers stuck. - Own handoffs: when Fin escalates, where it routes, and what context it passes so customers never repeat themselves. - Dig into low CSAT ratings and dead ends, and fix the root cause. - Handle a small volume of tickets to stay close to real customer problems. LAUNCH READINESS: OWN FIN'S READINESS FOR EVERY LAUNCH Vanta ships fast, and customers ask about new features the day they launch. We win as one team and lead with resilience, so Fin is ready on day one, even when plans change late. - Partner early with Product, Engineering, and Customer Education to get source-of-truth content before features ship. - Have Fin tested and ready on launch day, then watch closely and close gaps fast. - Evaluate new Fin capabilities and recommend which to adopt. How to be successful in this role: - Support expertise: 3+ years in technical support at a B2B SaaS company, including troubleshooting complex customer issues. TSS / Sr. TSS experience is preferred. - AI support tool experience: hands-on experience with AI-powered support tools, as a user or an admin, and a clear view of where they work well and where they don't. - Structured writing: you can turn a messy process into clear, well-organized knowledge that both people and AI can use. - Data-driven decisions: you're comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data, spotting trends, and using them to decide what to fix first. - Systems thinking: when you see a bad answer, you ask what in the system caused it, then fix that so it doesn't happen again. - Customer judgment: you can tell when an answer is technically right but still a bad experience, and when a customer needs a person. - Nice to have: Experience administering Intercom and Fin, including guidance, snippets, Procedures, or AI Insights. - Nice to have: Background in knowledge management, content design, or writing for conversational interfaces. - Nice to have: Experience leading a support tool rollout or migration. - Nice to have: Exposure to security, compliance, or GRC concepts. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: - Industry-competitive salary and equity - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents - Health & wellness stipend - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office - Family planning benefits - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time - 11 company-paid holidays - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. #LI-remote At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. matches.d: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases. We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients. For the expansion of our international DT Commercial team, argenx is looking for Product Owner – DT Commercialization - DT Medical Affairs. This role will own the technology vision and value delivery for our Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation capability within Digital Technology (DT) Commercial. It is accountable for translating the goals of our Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation teams into a clear product vision and a prioritized backlog for platforms that support scientific exchange. By acting as the primary liaison between medical experts and technical teams, ensuring all solutions meet key compliance standards, and enabling the use of technology to generate insights, this position is directly responsible for ensuring our digital ecosystem supports effective and compliant medical engagement. Roles & Responsibilities Own the digital product vision and prioritize the backlog for key Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation platforms, including Medical CRM and scientific exchange tools. Act as the primary medical-to-tech liaison, translating complex scientific engagement and evidence generation needs into clear, actionable user stories. Ensure all digital solutions strictly adhere to non-promotional regulations and medical integrity standards, embedding compliance into the design process. Drive the development of tools and analytics to capture and analyze global medical insights, enabling data-driven strategic decision-making for Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation leadership. Act as the steward for the end-to-end user experience for Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation platforms, ensuring they are intuitive and effective for field medical teams and HCPs. Define and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for success, continuously measuring the value and impact of the technology on scientific engagement objectives. Provide clear, day-to-day direction to various delivery teams on what to build next, ensuring alignment with Medical Affairs priorities. Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery teams, providing constant feedback and clarification on medical requirements to empower effective execution. Skills and Competencies Deep knowledge of product management principles, particularly in defining a product vision and strategy that aligns with Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation goals. Skilled in translating complex scientific or medical business needs into clear requirements and user stories for technical teams. Ability to own and prioritize a product backlog based on scientific value and strategic importance within a regulated pharmaceutical environment. Expert knowledge of the legal and regulatory compliance framework governing non-promotional activities and scientific exchange in the pharmaceutical industry. Knowledge of the digital technologies that support Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation, such as Medical CRM and platforms for insight gathering and scientific content dissemination. Ability to work collaboratively and effectively together within cross-functional teams and networks. Demonstrated communication skills, within a multi-cultural and multi-lingual global environment. Is agile and demonstrates adaptability, comfort with ambiguity, trust-building, and resilience. Drives toward outcomes. Ambitious, inquisitive naturally, a quick study, with demonstrated eagerness to continuously learn, self-improve and develop. This includes being comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a diverse environment. Passionate and prepared to lead and contribute to our culture, which is driven by our corporate values of co-creation, innovation, empowerment, excellence, and humility. Education, Experience & Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master Degree preferred in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related fields. 5+ Years experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Business Analyst with a focus on delivering solutions for Medical Affairs, Clinical, or R&D functions. 5+ Years experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, with a strong understanding of Medical Affairs and Evidence Generation business processes and compliance requirements. 5+ Years experience owning a product roadmap and using KPIs to measure and communicate the value of technology solutions to scientific or medical stakeholders. matches.d: About Aspira For more than 40 years, Aspira has been the market-leading provider of software and services that help public agencies protect natural and cultural resources while making them accessible for all. Our platform supports everything from campground reservations to hunting licenses, helping millions of people discover, enjoy, and care for the outdoors. We share our client partners’ mission: to steward resources for future generations, create opportunities for genuine enjoyment of the outdoors today, and expand access so more people can experience its benefits. Aspira is transforming its technology and service model to give agencies more capacity and insight—streamlined tools, smarter automation, and better connections with their communities. Our goal is simple: make it easier for our clients to conserve what matters most and for their customers to enjoy it to the fullest. FYI Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Aspira is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas, now or in the future. As part of our hiring process, candidates may be required to complete an identity verification check conducted through Checkr, a secure third-party service provider. This step helps confirm the authenticity of applicant identities and supports a fair, secure hiring process for all candidates. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this notice and consent to the potential inclusion of an identity verification step as part of the interview process. The Ideal Candidate The Client Delivery Project Manager (PM) is a versatile, technically fluent, client-focused project management role responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering work across the full client lifecycle. This includes RFPs, contracting, implementations, platform transitions, production migrations, renewals, and ad hoc client initiatives. As part of Aspira 's PMO, Client Delivery Project Managers act as the operational backbone for client-facing work, partnering closely with Account Management, Product, Engineering, Transition, Implementation, Legal, Finance, and Leadership. They bring clarity to complex efforts, reduce risk during periods of change, and continuously improve how Aspira delivers for clients. Key Responsibilities Implementation & Platform Migration Management Own a variety of implementation projects end-to-end, including feature implementations for existing clients, new client implementations, new platform migrations, and client transition-out projects. Lead project kickoffs and maintain a regular governance cadence, including status calls, risk and issue tracking, and executive updates, to keep stakeholders aligned throughout each project. Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and dependency tracking across all implementation, migration, and transition-out work. Identify risks, blockers, and decision points early; escalate and drive resolution to maintain momentum. Manage change requests when project work expands beyond the signed Scope of Work, keeping the client and internal teams aligned on the impact to scope and timeline. Coordinate end-user training, communication, and enablement materials so client teams feel confident and equipped to adopt new features, platforms, or transitions at go-live. Own user acceptance testing coordination and go-live readiness sign-off, including a post-launch hypercare period to confirm stability before formal project close. Ensure every implementation, migration, or transition-out project is organized, predictable, and client-centered. End-to-End Client Lifecycle Management Create a cohesive, consistent client experience across the full lifecycle, from RFP through implementation, migration, renewal, and (if needed) transition-out, coordinating with Aspira 's internal teams throughout. Serve as a continuity anchor for clients, ensuring smooth handoffs between lifecycle phases and teams. Partner closely with Account Management to translate contracts, statements of work, and commitments into actionable, sequenced project plans, and maintain a strong working relationship with the client partnership team throughout. Support ad hoc client initiatives by applying consistent project management practices to maintain predictability and quality. RFP & Proposal Execution Lead RFPs as formal projects, responsible for planning, sequencing, and execution. Coordinate cross-functional contributors (Account Management, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Leadership). Assign writers and reviewers, track inputs and dependencies, and manage deadlines. Review and edit responses for clarity, consistency, and alignment with client needs. Plan and coordinate demos, including scoping, scripting, scheduling, and readiness tracking. Continuously improve RFP processes through templates, standards, and repeatable workflows. Revenue Growth & Upsell Support upsell of previously released modules within the existing client base, partnering with Account Management to identify adoption gaps and build the case for expansion. Create and maintain project templates for enabling existing modules, so features that have already been built can be turned on quickly without a full new implementation cycle. Track module adoption across the client base and use that data to help prioritize which upsell opportunities to pursue next. Cross-Functional Coordination Act as a central point of coordination across Product, Engineering, Implementation, Transition, Account Management, and external partners. Coordinate with external vendors and third-party partners involved in implementation or migration work, ensuring their deliverables stay aligned with the overall project timeline and scope. Take ownership of resolving cross-team conflicts in priority or timing. Maintain clarity around ownership, expectations, and timelines across all workstreams. Documentation, Standards & Operational Excellence Document end-to-end client lifecycle and implementation workflows for internal reference and onboarding. Establish and maintain templates, playbooks, timelines, and best practices. Maintain accurate, current project documentation, client records, and delivery artifacts so every project stays organized and easy to hand off. Follow Aspira 's PMO-established standards, templates, and processes, while contributing frontline project experience back into the PMO to continuously refine and enhance those methods. Drive continuous improvement across internal workflows and cross-functional collaboration. Qualifications Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional projects such as RFPs, implementations, migrations, or transitions. Strong organizational, documentation, and process improvement skills. Comfortable coordinating across technical and non-technical teams. Clear, confident communicator with strong client-facing skills. Adaptable, emotionally intelligent, and able to thrive in an evolving environment. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technical concepts and systems, and to take ownership without waiting for direction. Prior experience implementing or supporting SaaS platforms (implementation, onboarding, or platform migration work). Working knowledge of data migration concepts: environment tiers (DEV/QA/UAT/PROD), data validation and reconciliation, cutover, and rollback planning. Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including sprint or release cycles, backlog and ticket management, and QA/testing phases, sufficient to plan around and coordinate effectively with Product and Engineering. Comfort reading and translating technical documentation, such as tickets, release notes, and migration plans, for non-technical stakeholders. Desired Hardware and Software Competencies Proficiency in Monday.com or an equivalent project management platform for day-to-day project management. Proficiency in Jira, used to track engineering-owned work such as tickets and releases. Experience with Confluence, Microsoft 365, or similar tools. Desired Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management certification. 3-5 years of project management, program management, or client delivery experience (SaaS, GovTech, services, or large-scale change initiatives preferred). Exposure to system implementations or platform migrations requiring careful documentation and cross-team coordination. Experience supporting RFP responses, proposal writing, or account growth and upsell initiatives. Experience working within a PMO or standardized project governance structure. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum practices; Scrum Master or related certification a plus. Equal Employment Opportunity RA Outdoors, LLC dba Aspira is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Aspira is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs and practices, consistent with applicable law. matches.d: Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments! Summary: As a Sr. Technical Project Lead, you will lead complex HL7 integrations across EHRs, hospitals, State Health Information Exchanges (HIEs), and third-party data partners, expanding and supporting connectivity across our nationwide healthcare network. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical liaison partnering closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive successful implementations and ensure alignment across technical requirements, business objectives, project scope, and delivery timelines. Your work will be crucial in enhancing interoperability, strengthening the exchange of real-time, actionable patient care events, and advancing data-sharing capabilities across the healthcare ecosystem. You will support the ongoing technical health of a portfolio of accounts by proactively managing integrations, monitoring risk, and helping ensure successful customer outcomes. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with Engineering, Growth, Account Management, Implementation, Product, and Support. What You’ll Do: Lead the technical implementation of Bamboo Health HL7 product offerings for healthcare entities, executing test plans, analyzing message structure and data quality, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating with Engineering and external partners through production launch Function as a subject matter expert on specifications across customers segments ensuring that all technical and business requirements are met during the integration process Build and maintain subject matter expertise on Bamboo Health ’s products as team expertise evolves. Serve as the Technical Account Manager for assigned Tier 1 accounts, providing ongoing oversight of complex integrations, proactive communication of technical risks, and resolution of integration issues. Partner with data sources and internal teams to maintain HL7 mappings, implement configuration changes, and ensure reliable connectivity and data exchange Proactively identify implementation risks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, partnering with technical teams to develop scalable and sustainable solutions Address high-priority customer escalations, applying SQL-based data analysis to identify root causes and guide internal and external stakeholders toward resolution Use AI and automation tools to accelerate documentation, status reporting, and other administrative work, and surface new use cases as they emerge (e.g., summarization, task routing, or data parsing). Support active implementations through mapping, testing, validation, and issue resolution activities. Build relationships with key customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. Begin incorporating AI-supported tools into your day-to-day work—whether through analysis, documentation, or task management. In 6 months… Independently manage technical implementation phases of integration projects, ensuring that Bamboo Health ’s integration requirements are met and project documentation is accurate Provide subject matter expertise to key stakeholders on integrations, ensuring seamless data exchange Assume Technical Account Manager ownership for assigned Tier 1 accounts, serving as a trusted technical resource for customers, HIE partners, and internal stakeholders. Contribute to Technical Services quality initiatives, including the development, tracking, and reporting of key performance and data-quality metrics. In 12 months… Manage complex implementation projects through delivery, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen technical partnerships and improve processes leading to quality outcomes Serve as a trusted Technical Account Manager and HL7 subject matter expert for Tier 1 accounts, proactively managing integration health and technical escalations Drive improvements across Technical HL7 Services by leveraging quality metrics and integration trends to identify opportunities for greater data quality, efficiency, scalability, and standardization What You Need: A mission-driven focus with a passion for spearheading change in complex healthcare environments 5+ years of professional experience independently managing healthcare projects involving cross-functional internal and external stakeholders with excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail Proven experience with HL7 standards and specifications is required Experience with integration engines (such as Mirth) is a plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and collaborate across technical and non-technical stakeholders in a remote environment focused on empathy, self-awareness, and respect for others Proficient in writing and executing SQL queries to analyze large data sets High proficiency in Microsoft 365 for creating reports, presentations, and managing communications Experience with Atlassian products (Jira and Confluence) for project management, team collaboration, and knowledge sharing Proficiency with Salesforce products is a plus BA/BS degree or equivalent experience Comfort using or learning AI-supported tools (e.g., ChatGPT, CoPilot, or role-specific tools) to improve daily workflows. A forward-thinking, curious mindset with an openness to experimenting with new technologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to apply sound technical judgement in providing solutions Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving environments. Ability to work effectively in a remote-first environment, ensuring high-quality virtual interactions with minimal distractions. The ability to travel periodically for work What You Get: Join one of the most innovative healthcare technology companies in the country. Have the autonomy to build something with an enthusiastically supportive team. Learn from working at the highest levels and on the most strategic priorities of the company, including from world class investors and advisors. Receive competitive compensation including health, dental, vision and other benefits. Our Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions enable healthcare professionals to see and treat every individual as a whole person by providing the right information, at the right time – regardless of physical, behavioral or social barriers. We’re a great place to work because we care. We continually seek to learn about our differences and ensure the unique perspectives and contributions of all employees are welcome, valued and celebrated. matches.d: About ev.energy We are building the world's largest EV-centric virtual power plant (VPP). By connecting to vehicles, chargers, batteries, solar, and other distributed energy resources, we turn households into flexible grid assets that balance supply and demand, preventing blackouts and reducing reliance on fossil fuels. We are scaling rapidly across North America and Europe. We are moving fast, we are AI-first, and we are looking for builders who want to power the grid of the future. About the role ev.energy grows through partnerships: with utilities, with the commercial team selling into them, and with the hardware and integration partners whose devices connect to our platform. We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to own those relationships end-to-end — the connective tissue between our commercial team, our external partners, and our engineering and product teams. What you’ll do Own a portfolio of technical partner relationships (roughly 6–10 to start), inheriting integration-partner relationship management as it moves into the team — the trusted bridge between what partners and commercial need and what engineering delivers Lead complex integrations from requirements discovery and scoping through project planning, testing, and launch to production Champion the value of our platform APIs and integrations — conveying use cases, benefits, and the integration process to partners and internal stakeholders alike Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Commercial, and Support to keep everyone aligned on the critical path and on schedule Develop repeatable playbooks so each new integration is faster and more reliable than the last Define partner-success metrics beyond uptime and SLAs, and communicate program status, risks, and ROI to leadership AI-first ways of working Use AI tooling (Claude and equivalents) as a core part of how you work — drafting partner-facing docs and integration specs, synthesizing status across programs, and turning your playbooks into repeatable, partly-automated workflows We're an AI-first company with agentic routines and shared internal tooling; you'll lean on it to stay on top of a broad portfolio and help shape how program management works in an AI-native org What we're looking for 5+ years in technical program management, product management, partnerships, or a related role Strong technical fluency — comfortable with REST APIs, authentication, and integration patterns (e.g. OpenADR, DERMS, utility platforms) — paired with a genuine commercial mindset Excellent external communication: you can lead a technical overview for a partner and a status update for an exec with equal ease A demonstrated ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and drive commitments without direct authority Also nice to have Experience in energy, EV, IoT, or another partner-integration-heavy domain A track record of building the program-management function at a small or scaling company, not just running project Salary, benefits & how we work The salary range for this role is $108,000-$132,300 USD. Key benefits include: Cash amount of up to 10% of your monthly salary, to cover the cost of buying or leasing an EV Equity - you'll own a part of the business through our share options program Healthcare options - to help keep you and your family in tip-top condition (provided by Cigna & Guardian) Life and disability insurance Co-working access via WeWork (if you'd like it) Annual 'Team Week' whole company offsite L&D allowance of $1,300 per year - everyone is learning, developing and challenging themselves so we have a professional development fund per year for you to learn new skills You can find out more about our full range of perks and benefits here. Location & how we work This role is fully remote in the US, but we're specifically looking for someone based in EST. The majority of people at ev.energy work on a fully remote basis, with a small number of roles based on-site in our testing sites. This means that most of our people work from home, but we're happy to provide co-working subscriptions if you'd like to spend time at a WeWork (or other co-working space close to you). We balance our remote set up by getting everyone together once a year for an offsite, as we know that spending time together IRL is super important. Belonging at ev.energy We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity: we do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status. If you'd like a copy of our DE&I policy you can reach us at . We'll always do our best to accommodate reasonable adjustments to the interview process if needed - just let us know. matches.d: Standard Job Description Join Lockheed Martin’s digital transformation journey as we accelerate the OneLM Mission-Driven Transformation through our 1LMX program. This strategic priority is reshaping our operations and business processes to better serve our customers in terms of cost, quality, and capabilities, while delivering the speed, agility, and insights necessary to stay ahead of rapidly-evolving threats. The Lockheed Martin Enterprise Business Transformation & Enablement organization team is hiring an mid-level ERP Business Analyst to support their corporate-wide business transformation leveraging the SAP S/4HANA platform and partner products. This particular role sits within the EBDT Portfolio and is assigned to the Cost Accounting Team within the Finance ART. In this role, you will support process design, system configuration, testing, and training. This role will require you to have both business and technical acumen in order to support functional spec definition, technical solution design and development estimate efforts. Your ability to develop a technical solution with innovative and leading technologies through performance of system configuration, assist with clarification of requirements, and performance of component and integration testing activities is key to transformation delivery. You will work in a scaled agile scrum team comprised of business representatives and IT employees to complete system configuration and software development based on business requirements. Major applications that will be utilized in this position will include SAP S4, integration with Accounting and Tax Solutions, Document Management Systems, and Data Analytics Systems. You have a strong background in SAP software, with experience in implementing various SAP components and ensuring their long-term health and efficiency through operational and maintenance (O&M) support, also known as sustainment. Ability to use your skills in configuring SAP and integration with other partner products to meet the specific needs of organizations. Your expertise is rooted in the finance and accounting domain, where you have a deep understanding of the financial processes and systems that SAP supports. With a comprehensive understanding of the software development life cycle, you're able to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders, making you a valuable asset in a variety of roles. This role is fully remote. US Citizenship required due to system access. matches.d: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara , we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara ’s Strategic Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara ’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal. In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara 's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. All the while building relationships with the customer, helping them learn our system, and overall ensuring a successful customer relationship. Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within. This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara ’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. May require travel to customer sites up to 10% of the time, including overnight stays. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara , you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara . This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You want to be with the best: At Samsara , we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. In this role, you will: Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform. Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to large-scale customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment. Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage. Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health. Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara ’s technology, and work through challenges with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases. Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers. Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams. Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara ’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: 6+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred. This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence. Experience supporting or working with technical products. Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills. Excellent consultative skills with experience in end to end system implementations. Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software. Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment. Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues. Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution. An ideal candidate also has: Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards. Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies. The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below.
