Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @ Carrier . About This Role This business- and technically accountable ownership role will focus on transforming the contact center into an agentic, Salesforce-native operating model. As a SAFe Business Owner, you hold primary accountability for ROI, solution fit, governance, and compliance for the contact center value stream. You define what needs to be built and why , make trade-off decisions across AI agents, human agents, channels, and integrations, and ensure delivery teams deliver outcomes—not just features. You will lead the shift from a traditional, human-centric service model to an agentic contact center on the Salesforce stack—where AI agents resolve work autonomously, escalate cleanly to humans with full context, and continuously improve using CRM + interaction data. Success is measured in containment, cost-to-serve, CSAT/NPS, FCR, AHT, and sustained adoption—not project on-time delivery alone. Key Responsibilities / What You Own: Agentic Contact Center Strategy & Outcomes Own the multi-year vision and value case for an agentic contact center on Salesforce (Agentforce / Agentforce Contact Center, Service Cloud, Omni-Channel, Knowledge, Data Cloud as applicable). Define target operating model: AI-first resolution, human-in-the-loop escalation, supervisor visibility, and continuous learning loops. Work with Contact Center Leadership to set and deploy KPIs (containment / deflection, AHT, FCR, CSAT, backlog, SLA, cost-per-contact) and the roadmap that moves them. Salesforce Service & Platform Steward Serve as the business/technical bridge for Salesforce Service capabilities supporting contact center transformation, including: Service Cloud case management, Omni-Channel routing/skills/queues Knowledge, macros, workflows/Flows, Service Console experience Voice / CTI patterns (Service Cloud Voice, Agentforce Voice, or telephony partner integrations such as Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9, etc.) Agentforce Service Agents / agentic orchestration (topics, actions, grounding, guardrails, escalation) Data Cloud / CRM context used to power personalization and agent decisions Translate service operations needs into solution designs that prefer Salesforce OOTB and platform-native patterns before custom build. Partner with Solution Architects, Platform Admins, Developers, Data, Security, and vendors to validate designs, PoCs, and production readiness—while retaining ownership of business intent and acceptance of the solution. Ensure integrations (e.g., SAP order/billing/status, identity, telephony, knowledge sources, analytics) are designed for agentic workflows—not only human screen-pop use cases. Product Backlog, Prioritization & Value Delivery Own the contact center transformation backlog at the epic/feature level: prioritize for measurable service outcomes, not request volume. Define clear problem statements, solution hypotheses, acceptance criteria, and definition of done for agentic use cases (e.g., order status, returns, appointment setting, billing inquiries, warranty, technical triage). Sequence capability releases: channel by channel / intent by intent—from assisted AI → autonomous containment with safe escalation. Reject or reshape requests that are pure process workarounds, low-ROI customizations, or misaligned with the Salesforce target architecture. Operating Model, Governance & Adoption Establish governance for AI agents: topic ownership, action inventory, grounding/data access, Trust Layer / responsible AI controls, escalation rules, auditability, and human override. Partner with contact center operations, WFM, QA, training, and knowledge teams to redesign processes, scripts, QA scorecards, and coaching for AI + human collaboration. Drive change management focused on behavior and metric change (how supervisors and agents work), not tool rollout alone. Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, SDLC, and SAFe / Agile delivery practices. Required Qualifications: 5+ years in customer service / contact center digital platforms. 5+ years hands-on Salesforce Service Cloud in enterprise environments. Bachelor’s degree. Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated ownership of contact center technology transformation involving CRM + omnichannel + voice/digital channels (not just CRM case management enhancements). Practical experience designing or deploying AI-assisted or agentic service (Agentforce, Einstein bots / generative service, conversational AI, intelligent routing, or comparable enterprise agent platforms). Working fluency with Salesforce service architecture concepts: Omni-Channel, Flows, Knowledge, entitlement/case lifecycle, CTI/voice integration patterns, Experience Cloud / self-service (as relevant), and data/integration implications. Ability to evaluate build-vs-configure decisions, identify Salesforce OOTB fit vs. customization risk, and partner credibly with architects and engineers. Experience defining reporting/data requirements for contact center KPIs and using operational data to prioritize backlog (containment, AHT, FCR, CSAT, etc.). Familiarity with ERP/service process integrations (e.g., SAP order-to-cash / billing / status) sufficient to design end-to-end agentic journeys—not as a primary SAP functional consultant. SAFe Business Owner / Product Leadership Experience acting as (or equivalent to) a SAFe Business Owner, Product Manager, or Digital Product Owner for a complex value stream—accountable for ROI and solution outcomes, not only coordination. Comfortable leading PI Planning participation, prioritizing Features/Epics, accepting increments, and making risk/trade-off decisions live with delivery teams. Strong stakeholder leadership across Operations, IT, Architecture, Data, Security, and vendors—through influence and decision quality, not project control. Contact Center Domain Deep understanding of omnichannel service (voice, chat, email, messaging, self-service), workforce realities, escalation design, and QA/coaching impacts of automation. Proven ability to redesign service processes for automation-first resolution with safe human handoff. Hands-on experience with Agentforce , Agentforce Contact Center / Voice, Service Cloud Voice, or equivalent CCaaS + CRM unification programs. Salesforce certifications (Service Cloud Consultant, Administrator, AI Associate / Agentforce-related credentials) or equivalent demonstrable platform depth. Experience with Data Cloud, Prompt Builder, Einstein Trust Layer, or LLM grounding/guardrail patterns in production. Prior migration from legacy ACD/CCaaS or fragmented bot stacks onto Salesforce-centric service architecture. SAFe certification (SAFe Agilist / POPM) or demonstrated ART Business Owner experience. HVAC, manufacturing, distribution, or complex B2B/B2C service domain experience a plus. Education Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Operations, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree in platform and domain depth outweigh credentials . Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed. matches.d: Join CoolIT, an Ecolab Company, a global leader in Direct Liquid Cooling technology for data centers, supercomputers, and high-performance computing environments. An exciting and challenging position exists as a Technical Program Manager at CoolIT. As a member of the Program Group, you would be accountable for the planning, development and launch of numerous new product introductions (NPI’s) What’s in it For You Health Benefits: Employer-provided benefits coverage begins on the first day of the month following your date of hire. Employees can choose from a selection of medicals plans , along with dental and vision coverage, with premiums shared between the employer and employee. Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance: Employee-paid Life and Accidental & Dismemberment (AD&D) coverage Disability Coverage: Employer-paid premiums for Short-Term Disability (STD) and Long-Term Disability (LTD) coverage. 401(k) Retirement Plan : 2% employer-sponsored contribution. Paid Time Off: Three weeks of paid time off, six flex days, plus a one-week company-wide holiday shutdown. Professional Development: $1,000 annually to support professional development and continued learning. Work Environment: “Dress for Your Day” in a casual, professional workplace environment. Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment What You Will Do The Technical Program Manager (TPM) leads the Program Core Team and serves as its battle captain, orchestrating cross-functional execution, technical integration, and accountability. Through deep technical understanding and risk-based decision-making, the TPM drives alignment, challenges assumptions, and ensures customer commitments are translated into successful outcomes. This will be a remote role and will be reporting to the Portfolio Manager based in Calgary, Canada. Lead the Program Core Team to drive from concept assessment, technical execution, cross-functional integration, customer alignment to NPI launch readiness and be accountable for the success of the overall program/project. Build strong customer relationships by understanding business objectives, technical needs, decision drivers, and success criteria; support the KAM in developing new business opportunities and preparing customer proposals. Collect, clarify, and translate customer requirements into product requirements, technical scope, PRDs, program plans, and measurable deliverables. Drive solution development with engineering teams by challenging assumptions, facilitating design trade-offs, resolving technical issues, and aligning decisions to customer commitments and program risks. Support DFMEA activities and broader technical risk assessments across design, validation, manufacturability, reliability, supply chain, cost, schedule, and launch readiness. Develop and drive mitigation plans, escalation paths, recovery actions, and decision frameworks to protect customer commitments and launch outcomes. Coordinate engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, sales, business stakeholders, and customers to maintain technical alignment, decision velocity, and execution discipline. Monitor program health through integrated schedules, dependencies, action registers, risk logs, budgets, and customer-facing status reporting in partnership with Project Managers. Travel globally up to 10%-20% to support customer relationship development, requirements reviews, technical reviews, supplier engagement, production readiness, and launch activities. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline, with strong grounding in mechanical, thermal, fluid, or electromechanical product development. 5+ years in technical program management, product development, systems engineering, or NPI execution for complex engineered products. Proven ability to manage customer relationships, understand customer needs, and translate requirements into PRDs, technical scope, and executable plans. Strong engineering collaboration skills, with the ability to drive solution trade-offs across design, validation, manufacturability, reliability, cost, and schedule. Experience supporting DFMEA, technical risk assessments, root-cause analysis, issue resolution, and mitigation planning. Excellent communication and influence skills with customers, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, suppliers, and leadership. We thank every candidate in advance; however, we will contact only those selected for an interview. Please note: immigration sponsorship is not available for this role. Successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo background checks, including criminal record checks and education verification. ABOUT COOLIT, AN ECOLAB COMPANY Founded in Calgary, Alberta in 2001, CoolIT Systems is the leading Direct Liquid Cooling technology provider for data centers, supercomputers, and desktop computers. We design and manufacture solutions used by the largest tech companies globally. Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention. As demand for generative AI, high-performance computing and cloud solutions rapidly expands, there has never been a more exciting time to join our team. Annual or Hourly Compensation Range: $101,400 - $152,100 Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws. matches.d: Excella is a transformative technology firm that helps organizations unlock new possibilities. We believe the key to helping clients challenge the status quo and reach new heights lies in our talented people. That’s why we’re committed to developing talent and providing opportunities for career growth at every stage. Join our collaborative team dedicated to solving complex problems with sustainable solutions while building your future as a leader. At Excella , you’re empowered to make lasting impact, turning today’s challenges into tomorrow’s mission successes. Workplace locations look different for everyone. Excellians are a distributed workforce and whether you're working from your home office or a client site, we support a flexible work/life integration regardless of your location. We offer top of industry medical, dental, and vision benefits with multiple options to choose from such as an employer-contributed health savings account, infertility coverage, and orthodontia so you can select the plan that works best for you. Regardless of what stage of life you’re in, Excella wants to support you. We provide 8 weeks of Parental Leave, discounted pet insurance, and a Care.com membership with 3 back-up emergency child or elder care days annually – all available to you on your first day. Starting day one, every employee is bonus eligible and receives 15 days of paid vacation, 6 federal holidays, and 4 floating holidays. Doing your best work means having the best tools! Excella ’s TechEleX program provides you with multiple options to suit your technology needs. Choose between a variety of Mac or PC devices, and to ensure your hardware remains current, at the end of a 3-year period Excella will replace your existing computer with a new model from the program. Plus, we’ll even give you the original device to keep for your personal use! With Excella ’s Annual Internet Reimbursement benefit, all employees receive an additional $25 per month to help offset the cost of internet access. This initiative reflects our commitment to supporting you in staying connected and productive, no matter where you work. We'll invest in your career by providing 3 days of paid professional development every year, including an allowance for registration fees to attend classes, conferences, or obtain professional certifications. We encourage mindfulness and overall well-being through employee wellness events, a HeadSpace membership, as well as access to TalkSpace and mental health coverage through our medical plans. Overview We are looking for thought leaders in Agile, Product Management, and Business Analysis to join our team who are passionate about delivering innovative that meet real business needs. Our Agile Business Analysts thrive in collaborative, cross-functional teams—working closely with UX designers, developers, data specialists, and business stakeholders to shape and deliver features that align with the overall product strategy. We combine Agile methodologies with modern analysis techniques to define success, drive the product vision and strategy, and lead the creation and prioritization of feature roadmaps based on business value and user impact. Responsibilities: Collaborate with product leaders, designers, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to shape product direction and deliver valuable solutions from concept to launch. Define and evolve a product vision and strategy rooted in user needs, business objectives, and data. Lead discovery efforts, apply analysis techniques related to user research, mapping, and modeling, and conduct feasibility assessments to explore and validate product ideas. Create and maintain a product roadmap that balances short-term delivery with long-term innovation; ensure transparency and alignment across teams. Prioritize product features and capabilities based on value, effort, dependencies, and user feedback. Translate ideas into clear, testable user stories and success criteria; support agile events and iterative delivery. Establish and track key product metrics to evaluate performance and guide continuous improvement. Act as a bridge between business and technology, ensuring shared understanding of goals and outcomes. Support adoption planning and coordinate product rollouts using change management principles in collaboration with partners across the business. Proactively identify risks, blockers, and cross-team dependencies; take ownership of resolution paths. Help shape and evolve good practices across the team—encouraging collaboration, user focus, and agility. Mentor team members, share knowledge, and promote a product-thinking mindset across the organization. Lead and conduct functional testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), 508 compliance testing, etc. Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in product management, agile business analysis, or related roles within software or data product development. Proven ability to define, plan, and deliver end-to-end product solutions in cross-functional, agile environments. Experience transforming “requirements” to an evidence-based, prioritized product backlog. Skilled in writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting artifacts that enable efficient development. Familiarity with agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and backlog management practices. Ability to lead discovery work using a range of research methods and collaborate on iterative design. Comfortable working with data—able to define metrics, analyze performance, and use insights to drive decisions. Strong facilitation, presentation, and written communication skills. Adept at balancing multiple priorities, navigating ambiguity, and working across business and technical domains. This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary that Excella reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on factors such as skills, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top or bottom of the range. Your pay also includes the opportunity for an annual bonus in addition to the base salary. This variable pay opportunity is dependent upon the attainment of shared firmwide goals and objectives as determined by Excella ’s Executive Team. Certain eligibility and pro-ration rules apply. Should your experience and knowledge qualify you for a different position or title within Excella , we may consider you for positions that better align with your qualifications. In that case, we will provide the range for those positions as well. Pay Range $100,735—$142,165 USD Excella is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. matches.d: Who We Are Icon Health is a leading provider of value-based musculoskeletal (MSK) care, collaborating with payers and providers to enhance outcomes and experience for individuals. The company partners with health plans and risk-bearing providers to assume accountability for reduced total cost of care. By combining technology-enabled MSK providers with proactive care coordination and decision support services, Icon Health delivers multidisciplinary, evidence-based care. We founded Icon Health on the conviction that every patient should be genuinely delighted with their care experience. By prioritizing patient-centered practices, ensuring clear care goals across the entire clinical team, and placing clinicians at the heart of care delivery, we aim to transform a fragmented system into one that truly serves patients. Our model uses a team-based approach to care, integrating musculoskeletal expertise and primary care to achieve better patient outcomes. At Icon Health , we foster a culture that embraces bold thinking, rapid iteration, and practical problem-solving. We seek team members who relish challenging the status quo and thrive in vertically integrated roles—where ideas can swiftly move from concept to execution without layers of red tape. Above all, we value individuals who are eager to roll up their sleeves, tackle obstacles head-on, and create innovative solutions that improve the lives of our patients and our clinical partners. About the Role: The Strategic Operations Manager makes our care delivery and care coordination workflows better, faster, and more scalable. You'll work closely with clinical operations leads to find friction, redesign processes, and document them, then translate those improvements into clear requirements for our data and engineering teams to automate, measure, and build on. What You'll Do: Workflow design and improvement Map current operational workflows, including referral intake, outreach, scheduling, care coordination, and partner handoffs, and find bottlenecks and inconsistencies Design, test, and iterate on improved processes with clinical operations leads and front-line teams Create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, and playbooks so new workflows are adopted consistently across markets Define operational KPIs and service standards, and track performance to guide ongoing improvements Translating operations into data and engineering requirements Turn validated workflow changes into clear, prioritized requirements for data and engineering, including what to automate, what to measure, and what to build Partner with the product and data teams to make sure operational needs are reflected on the roadmap and in reporting Support rollouts of new tools and workflow changes, including training, feedback loops, and post-launch iteration Do ad hoc analysis to size operational problems and evaluate whether changes worked What You'll Bring: 3+ years in operations, process improvement, strategy and operations, or consulting, ideally in healthcare delivery or a high-growth company Experience mapping and redesigning complex, multi-stakeholder workflows Strong analytical skills (Excel or Sheets required; SQL or BI tools a plus) Ability to write clear requirements and work well with technical teams Organized and detail-oriented, with practical judgment about what will actually work on the front lines Nice to Have: Experience in care coordination, referral management, or clinical operations Familiarity with EHR workflows and payer or provider operations Lean Six Sigma, or similar process improvement experience We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based upon age, color, handicap or disability, ethnic or national origin, race, religion, religious creed, gender (including discrimination taking the form of sexual harassment), marital, parental or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. Job Type: Full Time. M-F Benefits: Flexible scheduling options (to be discussed in interview) Benefit package including medical, dental and vision effective on Day 1 Work Location: Fully Remote Important Notice: Protect Yourself from Recruitment Fraud To ensure you are communicating with a legitimate Icon Health representative, please not Verified Communication: All official emails from our team will only come from an @iconhealthco.com email address. Live Interviews: We never hire based on text or chat alone. Our multi-stage interview process always involves several live conversations with our team members via phone and/or web conference. Your Privacy: We will never ask for sensitive financial information, home office equipment fees, or payment at any point during the hiring process. matches.d: This is a remote position. Turn Marketplace fraud intelligence, AWS architecture, and Agile delivery into decisions that executives can act on. About the role Innosoft Corporation is hiring a Marketplace Program & Technical Strategist to support a national health insurance Marketplace program at a federal health agency. You will help design, scale, and manage complex, cross-organizational programs by combining program management, fraud subject matter expertise, Marketplace data analytics, and hands-on technical problem solving. If your background is in roles such as Technical Program Manager, Agile Program Manager, Management Analyst, or Fraud Program Lead, this role was built for you. Why this role National-scale federal healthcare program with direct executive visibility A rare mix of program leadership, fraud expertise, AWS, and Agile delivery in a single role Close collaboration with engineering, fraud, and policy teams Hiring now, with prompt follow-up for qualified candidates Location and schedule Full time. Remote within the continental United States. What you will do Program leadership and strategy Support the program lead in the design, scaling, and ongoing management of complex, cross-organizational Marketplace programs aligned with executive priorities. Drive resilience, modernization, and continuous-improvement initiatives across Marketplace systems. Guide application development and cross-capability teams toward sustainable outcomes. Help shape program roadmaps and delivery structures that integrate technical, fraud, and policy considerations. Fraud subject matter expertise Serve as a trusted fraud SME, informing Marketplace fraud operations, enrollment-integrity strategies, and decision-making. Advise leadership on fraud mitigation approaches, system impacts, and technical delivery considerations. Present fraud-related program updates in executive forums with clarity and alignment across stakeholders. Technical problem solving and AWS Diagnose and resolve Marketplace technical issues using strong knowledge of AWS services, cloud-native architecture, resilience patterns, monitoring pipelines, and deployment processes. Partner with engineering teams to turn program requirements into actionable solution designs and architectural improvements. Agile program management Manage multi-team backlogs, dependencies, sprint execution, and delivery cadence across Marketplace programs. Facilitate roadmap alignment, enable iterative delivery, and embed continuous-discovery practices. Change management and stakeholder engagement Lead change management so that new processes, technologies, and policies are understood, adopted, and sustained. Coordinate communication across Marketplace leadership, fraud teams, technical delivery teams, and policy partners. Translate complex technical and programmatic information into concise, actionable guidance for executives and non-technical stakeholders. Executive reporting and decision support Develop and deliver executive-ready dashboards, risk summaries, fraud insights, readiness assessments, and solution recommendations. Support executive decisions through structured analysis, data-driven insights, and clear evaluation of risks, impacts, and mitigation options. Policy and regulatory awareness (a plus) Apply working knowledge of Marketplace policy, regulatory requirements, and compliance frameworks so program strategies stay aligned with agency expectations, and partner with policy teams to build regulatory changes into program and technical planning. Eligibility U.S. person, able to obtain and maintain a federal Public Trust suitability determination. Work is performed within the continental United States. How to apply Apply with your current resume. To help us review your application quickly, please show your Marketplace or CMS experience, the AWS services you have worked with, and any Agile or project management certifications. Requirements What you need 5+ years of relevant experience in program management, technical strategy, or management analysis Experience with health insurance Marketplace systems (Federally Facilitated Marketplace, ACA exchange, or a comparable enrollment platform) Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native architecture, including resilience patterns, monitoring pipelines, and deployment processes Agile program management experience: multi-team backlogs, dependencies, sprint execution, roadmaps, and delivery cadence Fraud or enrollment-integrity subject matter expertise, with the ability to advise senior leadership Risk analysis and dependency management, including upstream and downstream impacts across a Marketplace ecosystem Executive-level communication, including dashboards, risk summaries, readiness assessments, and recommendations Change management and stakeholder engagement experience Minimum education Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, computer science, public health, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred qualifications Recent CMS or Federally Facilitated Marketplace experience (strongly preferred) Working knowledge of Marketplace policy, regulatory requirements, and compliance frameworks Marketplace data analytics experience Experience in a federal contract delivery environment Certifications Preferred: PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, or an AWS certification (Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate, or higher). Benefits Benefits Standard Employee Benefits. 50% Health Insurance Paid by Innosoft, Paid Vacation, 401K Match, STD LTD and AD&D paid by Innosoft. This range reflects the anticipated base salary and does not include bonus, benefits or other compensation. Corp-to-corp (C2C) engagements are also considered at $90 per hour. PCG offers clients a multidisciplinary approach to meet challenges, pursue opportunities, and serve constituents across the public sector. To learn more, visit . Plans, estimates, schedules and tracks project timelines and milestones using appropriate tools. Uses and refines best practices and tools for project execution and management. Drafts and submits budget proposals and recommends subsequent budget changes where necessary. Develops and delivers progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations. matches.d: At Summit , we build and operate the infrastructure behind some of the most critical applications in regulated industries. The work is complex, expectations are high, and the environments we support require precision and thoughtful execution. We specialize in enterprise-class Application Hosting, Managed Services, and Cloud Solutions, with deep expertise in compliance, security, and performance. Our focus is simple: make the complex manageable and deliver technology that works - reliably, securely, and at scale. Complex technology environments need someone who can see the whole picture: how the infrastructure works, where the risks are, and what the business will need next. As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) , you’ll be a key technical relationship partner for enterprise clients with complex infrastructure environments. You’ll develop a deep understanding of their business and technical goals, helping them maximize value from our platform while partnering with internal teams to mitigate risks, plan for future needs, and drive long-term success. You’ll own the ongoing technical relationship for your assigned clients, working across client stakeholders and Summit teams to connect strategy with execution. This role calls for deep infrastructure knowledge, sound judgment, and the ability to bring the right people together when the work gets complicated. What You’ll Do: Own the technical relationship across a portfolio of complex enterprise clients, serving as a trusted advisor to technical leaders and executive stakeholders. Develop deep knowledge of each client’s business, infrastructure, architecture, stakeholders, priorities, technical dependencies, and use of Summit services. Build relationships across client teams and identify opportunities to strengthen those connections over time. Lead proactive conversations about technical governance, operational health, capacity, resilience, scalability, technical debt, and infrastructure lifecycle needs. Identify risks and dependencies early, working with clients and Summit teams to develop plans before they become larger issues. Provide strategic technical recommendations and roadmaps aligned with each client’s business objectives and technology strategy. Bring technical insight and account context to QBRs, architecture discussions, business reviews, and strategic planning conversations. Partner with account teams on customer health, renewal readiness, and expansion opportunities grounded in client needs. Guide clients through major transitions, including onboarding, steady-state support, expansions, upgrades, and migrations. Maintain technical and relationship oversight during delivery to keep requirements, commitments, communication, and handoffs aligned. Lead structured remediation efforts for technically complex accounts that need elevated attention. Coordinate across Support, Engineering, Delivery, PMO, Operations, Sales, and other Summit teams to keep technical priorities visible and actions moving. Stay current on emerging technologies and infrastructure practices, translating relevant developments into useful guidance for clients. What You’ll Deliver: Trusted relationships with senior technical and executive stakeholders. A clear, current understanding of complex client environments and how Summit services support them. Technical recommendations and roadmaps that strengthen resilience, scalability, and long-term infrastructure health. Early visibility into technical risks, with clear plans and ownership for addressing them. Valuable QBRs, architecture discussions, and strategic planning conversations. Smooth transitions across sales, onboarding, delivery, projects, and ongoing support. Strong technical input into renewal planning and qualified expansion opportunities. Coordinated remediation efforts with clear client communication and internal accountability. You’ll Thrive in This Role If You: Bring deep experience in infrastructure design, implementation, architecture, operations, or technical advisory work. Have worked with complex enterprise environments and understand how infrastructure decisions affect critical business operations. Can connect a client’s business objectives to practical technical recommendations and longer-term plans. Build credibility with engineers, technical leaders, and executives. Translate complex technical topics into clear conversations and actionable decisions. Can guide work across multiple teams and drive accountability without direct authority. Spot risks, ask good questions, and follow through when the path forward is complicated. Stay curious about emerging technologies while keeping your recommendations grounded in what the client needs. Bonus Points: Experience in Technical Account Management, technical consulting, or another customer-facing advisory role. Experience in managed services, cloud infrastructure, hosting, MSP, or data center environments. Broad knowledge of public and private cloud, virtualization, compute, networking, storage, backup and disaster recovery, security, containers, and related technologies. Experience conducting architecture, capacity, resilience, operational health, or infrastructure lifecycle reviews. Technical certifications across AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, networking, security, or related technologies. Familiarity with ITIL, TOGAF, or business analytics tools such as Power BI. How We Work at Summit How you approach the work matters just as much as what you do. At Summit , our core values show up in how we make decisions, work together, and support our customers. We build the infrastructure that keeps businesses running. We need people who take that seriously, and have fun doing it. Our Core Values: Empower our people Constant elevation Customer first Focus on outcomes Embrace curiosity Benefits Summit offers a total rewards package designed to support you at work, at home, and everywhere in between. Here’s a snapshot of what that looks like: Flexible Time Off (yes, really) – take what you need, we trust you to manage it Medical, Dental & Vision – comprehensive coverage with HSA/HRA options 401(k) with 4% match – we invest alongside you Parental Leave – paid time for the moments that matter most Life & Disability Insurance – built-in peace of mind Wellness Support – resources for your mental and physical health Free Colocation & Cloud Access – build and experiment in real environments Work From Anywhere – remote-friendly by design A low-ego, get-it-done culture – come as you are, do great work Compensation The salary range for this role is $115,000 – $130,000 annually . Compensation is based on the responsibilities of the role, experience, skills, geographic market, and internal equity. We believe great careers are built one step at a time, and compensation should grow alongside your impact. Internal candidates may see variations based on current role, compensation, and progression at Summit . Same thoughtful approach, just with additional context. matches.d: Integration meets Innovation At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world. We’re looking for a highly organized and proactive Program Manager to strengthen alignment, execution, and operational discipline across Celigo’s product development organization. At Celigo, Product Operations empowers product teams to deliver high-impact solutions through clear operating models, strategic alignment, and scalable systems. We are evolving how we work - creating greater clarity from discovery through delivery and strengthening how teams collaborate to deliver measurable business value. As Product Development Program Manager, you will play a central role in operationalizing and reinforcing our product operating model. You’ll partner closely with Product Operations leadership to ensure teams move intentionally through the product lifecycle - from shaping opportunities to funded delivery and post-launch evaluation. This role is ideal for a seasoned program management professional who understands how modern SaaS product teams operate and enjoys bringing clarity to complexity. You’ll thrive if you’re energized by helping teams stay aligned, improving how work flows, and building trust through structure, communication, and follow-through. You will facilitate alignment sessions, coordinate readiness checkpoints, and support prioritization rhythms that keep work progressing predictably from discovery through delivery. You’ll connect people, processes, and tools - documenting decisions, tracking dependencies, and reinforcing accountability in a collaborative and supportive way. You won’t design the operating model - you’ll help bring it to life. Your impact will be visible in how seamlessly our teams operate, how confidently we commit, and how effectively we execute. What You’ll DoProgram & Alignment Leadership • Facilitate and operationalize key alignment sessions across the product lifecycle, including discovery alignment, triad syncs, Epic readiness reviews, and post-launch evaluations. • Prepare structured agendas aligned to the current stage of work and ensure each session results in clear decisions and next steps. • Proactively surface risks, dependencies, and misalignments early, coordinating across Product, Design, and Engineering to maintain momentum. • Ensure ideas, initiatives, epics, and stories move through the lifecycle in a consistent and intentional manner. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement • Provide visibility into overall initiative health across discovery, funded delivery, and post-launch impact. • Partner closely with Product Operations leadership to operationalize and reinforce the product operating model, identifying friction and strengthening execution discipline. • Support teams in consistently applying the defined lifecycle model, reinforcing clarity around expectations and sequencing. • Build and interpret dashboards and reports that reflect system health, translating insights into actions that improve focus and predictability. Stakeholder Management & communication • Build trusted relationships with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineering Leads across domains. • Act as a unifying presence across teams, promoting clarity, alignment, and structured collaboration. • Provide concise, audience-appropriate updates to leadership, clearly highlighting risks, tradeoffs, and dependencies. • Model operational rigor and strong cross-functional coordination, helping elevate the maturity of the product organization. Who are we looking for? Skills & Abilities • Ability to facilitate cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, and Design — particularly during ambiguity and early-stage shaping. • Skilled stakeholder manager who can influence without authority, build consensus, and diplomatically surface gaps. • Strong organizational discipline — meticulous in tracking decisions, risks, dependencies, and follow-through. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complexity clearly. Education & Experience • 5–10 years of experience in program or lifecycle management within a B2B SaaS product organization. • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or relevant field (or equivalent practical experience). • Strong understanding of modern product development practices (e.g., dual-track discovery & delivery, double-diamond, triad collaboration). • Solid grasp of the full product development lifecycle (PDLC), including discovery, funding alignment, delivery, and post-launch evaluation. • Hands-on experience with Jira and Jira Product Discovery. • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, cross-team initiatives in shared-resource environments. • Technical fluency in SaaS and web application environments; able to engage credibly with engineering and architecture discussions. • Experience operationalizing and strengthening product operating models within scaling organizations. • Experience working in environments with shared engineering pools and cross-team dependencies. • Experience supporting globally distributed product teams (e.g., US/India collaboration). • Familiarity with microservices or platform-based architectures. • Experience working within or closely alongside a Product Operations function. Who You Are • A natural systems thinker who brings clarity and structure to ambiguity without overcomplicating it. • Proactive and outcome-oriented — you don’t just track work, you improve how work flows. • A thoughtful communicator who keeps teams aligned, informed, and focused on what matters most. • Analytical and pragmatic — you anticipate risks, surface dependencies early, and address issues before they escalate. • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility with Product, Engineering, and Design. • Energized by helping teams operate with greater focus, discipline, and predictability. • Comfortable navigating fast-paced environments where structure and adaptability must coexist. Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base salary between $90,000 and $130,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made. Celigo is proud to be • A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS. The only vendor to receive this award. • Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year • Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management. • Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform. Here you'll experience • Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency • A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented • Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field • Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily • Competitive compensation and benefits, including: • Three weeks of vacation (starting year one) • Wellness days and holidays to recharge • Parental leave and a generous benefits package • Monthly tech stipend • Recognition and career development opportunities Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. matches.d: At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong. The application window will be open until at least October 12th, 2026 . This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. Role Description As our Technical Program Manager, Colocation Service Delivery & Management, you will be responsible for managing the delivery and ongoing capacity management of complex, large-scale network infrastructure services, purchased from third-party suppliers nationwide. Within the gFiber team, you’ll work cross functionally to drive the completion of complex projects with the technical operations market teams, network engineering and network acquisition teams. These projects can include assessing leased dark fiber, colocation and bandwidth requirements to support new capacity demands and understanding the terms of new contracts including delivery targets and other technical requirements. Additionally, you’ll work to refine and evolve our projects, as well as deploy new technologies to markets and communities across the US. Within your team, you’ll foster an environment of learning and growth, both directly and indirectly, helping those around you develop and hone their skills. In this role, you’ll: Manage third-party vendor infrastructure delivery through build, network connectivity, acceptance, and documentation including project tracking and preparation of technical drawings and scopes of work. Oversee kickoff and regular project status meetings, collaborating across teams and escalating up vendor management chains when delivery time lines are at risk. Manage the quality of third-party leased Infrastructure documentation including accuracy and alignment between leased asset network inventory and commercial contract inventory. Identify opportunities to streamline processes to meet business needs and improve efficiency operationalizing solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and vendor partners. Manage and augment portfolio to continue to meet the ongoing needs of the business. At a minimum, we would like you to have: BA/BS degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent practical experience. 4 years of experience developing and managing network infrastructure programs, vendor management, and delivery of leased assets (including dark fiber, bandwidth services, and colocation space/power). 2 years of experience with space/power projects including build-outs in data centers or third-party colocation facilities. Experience leading project teams and/or vendor resources and defining/managing against success metrics. Experience ordering and managing colocation space, including AC & DC power consumption It’s preferred that you have: Colocation subject matter expertise including planning, designing, engineering of data center and standalone colocation. Experience with colocation capacity headroom management, including (AC and DC) power consumption analysis in alignment with evolving business requirements. Capability to engineer colocation sites including necessary infrastructure supporting OSP to ISP pathways and RFE development in alignment with business requirements. Experience with Central Office design practices, data center electrical and mechanical best practices, and space/power planning. Experience using project management and network inventory tools (e.g. Netcracker, ServiceNow, Sitetracker, and GSuite). Experience working on highly visible, time-sensitive projects with multiple stakeholder groups that drive revenue and customer targets. Contract negotiation and network acquisition experience The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $102,900 - $166,600 + bonus + benefits. As pay varies by location, your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process. gFiber is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or Veteran status. matches.d: Overview ROLE: The MRO Advisory Solutions team is expanding beyond its current assessment offerings into performance improvement and analytics consulting. The Consultant role owns the analytical and project execution core of new advisory offerings: the data collection and analysis, the deliverables, the workplan, and the day-to-day partner engagement that makes each engagement land. These offerings are new and pre-launch. That makes this a build role as much as a delivery role: the Consultant executes the pilots, instruments them against defined success criteria, brings back structured evidence about what should change, and helps convert what works into repeatable delivery assets so each offering can scale past its first few partners. Responsibilities RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Analysis and Deliverables · ~45% Owns the analytical core of every engagement — the Collect and Analyze phases, and the authorship of key deliverables. Assemble and validate the engagement data set: this could include registry data (STS Adult Cardiac Surgery, NCDR CathPCI, TVT), read-only EMR review, benchmark data, and partner-supplied operational and financial data Run the quantitative analysis each offering requires — this could include things like outcomes, length-of-stay, and adverse event variation; physician-level variation and documentation gaps; performance against public benchmarks; patient migration and leakage; competitive and market position Build the financial impact analysis: ROI and cost-impact modeling, revenue sizing, and growth opportunities Conduct the qualitative work — stakeholder interviews, surveys, and workflow review — and synthesize it against the quantitative findings Author draft findings, prioritized action blueprints, scorecards, and implementation or growth roadmaps in collaboration with the Advisory Lead and other team members Build and maintain the analytical assets each offering depends on: this could include data request templates, calculation and risk-adjustment logic, benchmark data sets, and performance trackers 2. Engagement and Project Management · ~30% Runs the day-to-day of 16- to 24-week engagements, projects may run concurrently. Build and maintain project workplans, including milestones, owners, dependencies, and status Serve as primary day-to-day partner contact for working-level and mid-management stakeholders Lead client-facing meetings for their engagements — kickoffs, working check-ins, and final presentations Facilitate working sessions and stakeholder interviews; hold partner-side owners accountable to deadlines Surface delivery risk, scope creep, and stakeholder resistance to the Advisory team early enough to act on Coordinate internal contributors across Clinical Services, Product, and other teams as projects require 3. Offering Build and Pilot Execution · ~25% Supports delivery of pilot offerings and helps shape what scaled offerings look like Support Business Development with offering-specific content and fit assessment during partner conversations Capture partner feedback and make recommendations on what should change in each offering to move from pilot to scaled offerings — phase length, data requirements, deliverable format, scope, etc. Document where an offering needs technology or data support and route as needed Convert what works into repeatable delivery assets: methodology documentation, deliverable and workplan templates, and enablement material for future delivery staff WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — FIRST 12 MONTHS Runs data collection, analysis, and deliverable creation without day-to-day direction All assigned projects completed within their contracted phase windows, with any extension attributable to partner-side issues rather than controllable delivery-side issues Recommendations are traced to a defensible, clinically- or operationally-grounded finding with solid financial implications outlined Physician and clinical stakeholders engage with the findings rather than dispute the data At least one offering materially revised — phase length, data requirements, or deliverable format — because of what execution revealed Brings a point of view to offering design and scaling discussions rather than only executing decisions made elsewhere Qualifications QUALIFICATIONS Required 3+ years in healthcare consulting or a related field, and 2–3+ years in an operational, quality, or performance improvement role within a health system Cardiovascular registry depth: STS Adult Cardiac Surgery Database, NCDR CathPCI Working knowledge of hospital clinical quality programs and registry data, or direct experience working with clinical quality or registry data Able to work in a pre-launch environment where the methodology is being built while it is being used Demonstrated ownership of the analytical core of client engagements — able to move from an incomplete data set to a defensible, quantified finding Strong project management: workplans, multi-stakeholder cadence, milestone tracking, and driving others to committed dates without formal authority Comfortable as the day-to-day partner contact with clinical and operational stakeholders Experience presenting analysis to, or facilitating improvement work with, physicians Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; working comfort with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and AI tools for analysis (e.g., Claude, Copilot) Clear written communication — able to draft a deliverable that needs editing, not rewriting Preferred Familiarity with public performance measures and their methodologies — STS star ratings, CMS Care Compare, U.S. News — and with how risk adjustment and documentation drive them Formal performance improvement training: Lean, Six Sigma, or the IHI Model for Improvement Clinical, HIM, or CPHQ background Prior experience taking a service offering from pilot to repeatable delivery Project management experience or certification (e.g., PMP, CAPM) Total matches.d: Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG , we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future. Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes. Position Summary The Senior Program Manager, Customer Validation is responsible for defining and executing customer validation strategies that help ensure products are ready to deliver exceptional customer experiences before launch. Operating as a highly autonomous individual contributor, you will serve as the customer validation subject matter expert for products moving through alpha, beta, launch readiness, and post-launch learning. You will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Quality, Operations, and Product Research to determine what customer evidence is needed, how it should be collected, and what it means for product readiness. This role goes beyond traditional beta program management. You will design validation strategies, define customer cohorts, develop testing methodologies, analyze customer feedback and sentiment, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence product scope, readiness, and launch decisions. You will help transform customer validation into a scalable discipline that provides product teams with confidence they are building experiences customers will love while ensuring launch decisions are grounded in meaningful customer evidence. Primary Responsibilities Customer Validation Strategy & Planning Own customer validation strategy for products progressing through alpha, beta, launch readiness, and post-launch learning activities. Define validation plans, success criteria, customer cohorts, participant requirements, testing activities, and measurement approaches. Determine what customer evidence is required to evaluate functional readiness, customer sentiment, usability, adoption potential, and overall experience quality. Partner with Product Researchers to leverage research insights and translate them into later-stage validation and measurement strategies. Establish scalable methodologies, frameworks, and best practices for customer validation across the organization. Alpha and Beta Program Design & Execution Design customer validation programs that assess both product functionality and customer experience via surveys and in lab testing. Develop surveys, feedback mechanisms, testing activities, and measurement plans that generate actionable customer insights. Partner with beta operations teams responsible for participant recruitment, fulfillment, communications, and logistics. Ensure validation programs accurately represent target customer populations through appropriate cohort selection and segmentation strategies. Identify validation risks, gaps, and dependencies while driving programs to successful completion. Customer Insights & Readiness Recommendations Analyze quantitative and qualitative feedback to identify customer experience opportunities, product readiness concerns, and launch risks. Measure and evaluate customer sentiment, satisfaction, confidence, and perceived value in addition to product functionality. Synthesize customer feedback into clear recommendations for Product, Engineering, Design, and leadership teams. Develop executive-ready reports, readiness assessments, and customer validation summaries. Translate complex customer feedback into practical actions and business recommendations. Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence Serve as the customer validation SME for assigned products and initiatives. Partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Quality, Operations, Customer Support, and Research teams throughout the product lifecycle. Challenge assumptions, identify customer risks, and advocate for customer needs throughout development and launch planning. Escalate readiness concerns and help teams make informed decisions regarding scope, timing, and launch readiness. Drive alignment across stakeholders while operating with substantial autonomy and influence. Required Skills & Functional Dimensions Customer Validation Expertise: Ability to translate product questions, risks, and requirements into effective customer validation strategies and programs. Program Leadership: Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines. Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyze customer feedback, identify meaningful patterns, and develop actionable recommendations. Survey & Measurement Design: Experience developing customer surveys, feedback mechanisms, and measurement frameworks that generate reliable insights. Technical & Product Fluency: Ability to effectively partner with Product Management and Engineering teams and translate technical requirements into customer-facing validation activities. Executive Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence decisions through clear, evidence-based recommendations. Customer Advocacy: Passion for representing the customer's perspective and ensuring customer evidence informs product decisions. Autonomous Execution: Ability to operate independently, define strategy, manage ambiguity, and drive outcomes with limited direction. Required Education & Experience Experience: 5+ years of experience in Customer Validation, Beta Programs, Product Operations, Program Management, Product Development, Technical Program Management, or a related field. Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated success partnering with Product, Engineering, Design, and Operations teams to deliver complex product initiatives. Customer Insights & Analysis: Experience analyzing customer feedback and translating data into actionable product recommendations. Program Development: Proven experience developing structured testing, validation, customer feedback, or product readiness programs. Technical Product Experience: Experience supporting the development or launch of hardware, software, platform, AI, energy, mobile, or connected product experiences. Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Human Factors, Psychology, Product Development, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world. At Nscale , our Global Data Centre Systems Engineering team designs, standardises, and scales the systems that keep our data centres running at peak performance. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscale r, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future. About the Role Nscale is hiring a Technical Program Manager to drive strategic, cross-functional initiatives within Global Data Centre Systems Engineering. This role combines program management, process engineering, and business analysis to turn operational needs into clear, measurable delivery plans and scalable solutions. You will connect data centre infrastructure teams with partner functions across Nscale , leading discovery, defining requirements, coordinating delivery, and communicating progress and business value for initiatives with senior leadership visibility. Experience required: 5+ years in technical program management, project management, PMO operations, business analysis, or program coordination within infrastructure, industrial, hardware-intensive, or similarly complex environments. What You'll be Doing Lead strategic initiatives. Own cross-functional work across analytics, metrics, data integrations, operational tooling, and systems engineering initiatives. - Own delivery discipline. Plan and govern scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, stakeholder communications, and measurable outcomes. - Lead discovery and assessment. Run cross-functional sessions to understand business needs, operational pain points, process gaps, and technical requirements; assess current-state workflows and recommend practical future-state options. - Translate needs into execution. Define clear business and system requirements, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and delivery plans. - Engineer scalable processes. Create and maintain process maps, workflow diagrams, swim lanes, systems diagrams, and other visual documentation; facilitate walkthroughs to confirm alignment. - Standardise where it matters. Promote harmonised standards, validation practices, and documentation while accounting for site-specific operational requirements. - Coordinate the full lifecycle. Guide initiatives from discovery and requirements through implementation, adoption, and operational handoff. - Communicate progress and value. Develop technical and executive-ready reporting that makes progress, risks, decisions, outcomes, and business value clear. - Maintain operational rigour. Apply relevant software development lifecycle methodologies. About You Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. - 5+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, PMO operations, business analysis, or program coordination within infrastructure, industrial, hardware-intensive, or similarly complex environments. - Experience delivering projects using waterfall, hybrid, and agile methodologies. - Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from discovery through implementation and operational adoption. - Strong expertise in requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, business and systems documentation, process mapping, and gap analysis. - Hands-on experience with project and work management tools such as Planview, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, or equivalent platforms, and diagramming tools such as Lucidchart, Figma, Visio, or mind-mapping software, with the ability to quickly learn Nscale 's tools. - Strong organisational skills and sound judgement when managing multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment. - Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. - Comfort working with KPI and SLA data to identify trends, surface insights, and support decision-making. - Ability to build consensus and maintain effective working relationships across organisational boundaries. - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed. Nice to Have An advanced degree in a relevant field. - Professional certification such as PMP, SAFe, or a comparable program, project, or agile credential. - Experience with Lean or Six Sigma. Experience supporting executive communications and decision-making forums. - Experience in data centre infrastructure, operational technology, or large-scale infrastructure delivery environments. Why this role matters Your success will be measured by the impact you have across our global data centre footprint, including: Documented, understood, and adopted workflows for priority systems engineering processes and systems. - Improved program delivery discipline, including project management compliance and timely risk and dependency escalation. - Cohesive views and presentations that support better operational and leadership decisions. - Reduced redundant tooling and broader availability of governed, quality-scored data for critical assets. - Clear translation of technical delivery progress into measurable business impact for leadership. What We Can Offer You At Nscale , you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core. The Operations Lead will oversee workforce coverage and readiness, coordinate resources across locations, resolve operational issues, and help ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery. The VA Transition Assistance Program (TAP) helps transitioning Service members and their families understand and access the VA benefits, services, and resources available to them as they transition from military to civilian life. VA delivers TAP services at more than 300 military installations across the Continental United States (CONUS) and areas Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS) through a network of Benefits Advisors, supported by standardized curriculum, training, program operations, and performance management. The program is part of the broader interagency Transition Assistance Program delivered in partnership with the Department of War, Department of Labor, and other Federal agencies. Please note that this position is contingent upon award (estimated December 2026). We expect this role to be remote, but periodic travel may be required to support program activities, customer meetings, and operations at U.S. and overseas locations. Travel frequency will vary based on program needs. Primary Responsibilities: Direct day-to-day operational execution of nationwide and OCONUS TAP field delivery across 300+ installations and a Benefits Advisor workforce of approximately 250-280 personnel. Maintain required Benefits Advisor staffing and operational coverage across permanent and itinerant locations, including continuity during vacancies, leave, training, and other staffing disruptions. Manage and coordinate regional/field leadership structures, personnel assignments, schedules, and operational priorities. Develop and issue operational directives, schedules, assignments, and implementation guidance necessary for consistent execution of Government requirements. Monitor vacancies, staffing levels, coverage requirements, attrition, onboarding, training status, and operational readiness; coordinate new-hire training needs with staffing forecasts. Coordinate field travel and temporary coverage while minimizing unnecessary temporary-duty travel and associated costs. Ensure timely event scheduling, operational reporting, and consistent delivery of VA Benefits and Services briefings and other required TAP support activities. Monitor installation-level service delivery, facilities, equipment, stakeholder relationships, and emerging issues that could affect performance. Track operational performance, risks, issues, staffing challenges, and corrective actions; escalate issues before they affect service delivery. Coordinate field activities with the Program Manager, Curriculum Lead, Data Analytics Lead, Government stakeholders, and installation-level partners. Support implementation of Government-approved operating procedures, curriculum changes, modernization initiatives, and program changes across the field organization. Maintain effective communications and knowledge sharing across geographically dispersed teams and locations. Ensure workforce onboarding, training, qualification, deployment, and continuing operational readiness. Contribute to weekly, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc operational reports and Government briefings and support rapid response to Government requests. Minimum Requirements: Bachelor's degree. Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience managing large-scale, geographically dispersed service-delivery operations involving workforce staffing, scheduling, coordination, and performance management. Demonstrated experience leading teams and managing projects of national scope within the Federal Government or Department of War (DoW). Proven experience managing the day-to-day operations of a geographically dispersed workforce. Proven experience developing and issuing operational directives and schedules necessary to effectively manage program operations. Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills. PMP or comparable project management certification.
